wwo.name: Cairo
wwo.method: Two connected arms follow the c.1895 drawn streets through old Cairo and the western expansion. The north arm crosses the Muski junction to Ataba, Azbakeya and Ismailia. The southern arm goes from Bab Zuwayla through the old street network to Muhammad Ali, northwest via Sheikh Rihan and south to the Citadel approach. Documented physical edges are the Nile bank, the Citadel wall and the Bab el-Wezir cemetery slope. The western river corridor is short and approximate. Untraced lanes retain fallback. Individual ordinary plots and the scene’s architectural massing are reconstructed within drawn blocks. This is a city-plan-scale candidate for 1900.

registration.reference: One WGS84 azimuthal equidistant frame for all geometry. Similarity fit in half-resolution working pixels relative to the 1920 × 2314 BnF reproduction. Present reference points register the period sheet only. Actual historical footprint edge precision is lower than the numeric coordinate format.
